footnotes: The 10-K reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 18.8% to $1.2B in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $230M from $341M.
Net income was $33.4M, or $0.74 per share, after a $201M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $243M and free cash flow $243M, versus −$19.7M; Sphere returned $50.0M through buybacks.
sources: Sphere Entertainment Co. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
